title: Good value and good fun
text:
Was a very fun day. 
The wine definitely flowed, the tapas was excellent and the tour guides knowledgable
author: Damian_R

title: Great and authentic trip!
text:
Great experience visiting the winery!! It was great to see and hear about the place and the history behind it. Beautiful place! 
Miguel (our guide from Viator) was very nice and talkative. He told us a lot about the city and gave us a lot of recommendations about places to visit during our stay.
author: Sandra_J

title: Wonderful local vineyard tour
text: Private tour, the tour host gave us great information about the provinces on the way to the vineyard. He was very helpful on the tour, easy to talk to, he interacted with us at the vineyard, he was fun and friendly. It was wonderful meeting the owner of the vineyard as he explained the history and process to their wine making. I definitely recommend this tour to anyone wanting to know more about local wine making.
author: robertkB2242YW
